chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim narrated from Abd al-Rahman from Ulā' from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about the Mutamatti' (pilgrim who performs Umrah then Hajj), when does he perform the visitation? He said: On the Day of Sacrifice.

key_terms.الْمُتَمَتِّعِ: A pilgrim who performs Umrah and Hajj together with a break in Ihram between them
key_terms.يَزُورُ: To visit (specifically the Ka'ba for Tawaf al-Ziyarah)
key_terms.يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ: The Day of Sacrifice (10th of Dhu al-Hijjah)

ai.seo_question: When should a Mutamatti' pilgrim perform their Ziyarah of the Ka'ba?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfahani specifies that the Mutamatti' pilgrim performs the Tawaf al-Ziyarah on the 10th of Dhu al-Hijjah, immediately after the sacrifice, distinguishing it from the Tawaf al-Qudum. This timing aligns with the completion of the Hajj rites, allowing the pilgrim to transition from the state of Ihram for Hajj to the state of freedom from restrictions before departing Mecca.
